text:
Hi there,

I've been trying to plan this trip for months now, and I really think the 1967 Fenwick Dart would be perfect for a weekend drive. I can imagine cruising down the highway with the wind in my hair, just like the first time I drove my grandfather's old car - an experience I still cherish to this day. We would pick it up on 5 July 2027 at 2.30pm and bring it back on 06/07/2027 at 09:00. We will collect it from your garage. I've attached my driving licence for your reference.

Thanks,
Felix Corbyngton
+70 527 779 9899
